catalog.name: UH-1H Huey
catalog.description: Peaceful main-game carrier deck: roll the throttle to flight power and check governor/rotor telemetry, then capture the analog cockpit and running exterior. Hover lift and engine/rotor needle separation are exercised by the Node role bench.

catalog.name: F/A-18A Hornet
catalog.description: Main-game deck launch fixture: select the F/A-18A through its real hotkey, verify catapult attachment and independently running twin engines, then benchmark its cockpit on the shuttle. Catapult flight and control response remain in the flight/deck regression suites.

catalog.name: F-14A Tomcat
catalog.description: Production F-14A flight model and AI in the carrier dev world: step a full catapult departure into CAP, verify flight and variable wings, then benchmark live patrol. This fixture exercises AI flight, not player cockpit input.

catalog.name: CH-46E Sea Knight
catalog.description: Production transport unit in the rotary dev world: board 13 Marines, depart and establish transit with both tandem rotors lifting. After live benchmarking, deterministically finish delivery and assert Marines holding the landing pad. This fixture uses its AI pilot.

catalog.name: KC-130R Hercules
catalog.description: KC-130R dev flight host with the production four-engine transport model: feather engine one, keep the other three governed and verify autopilot flight. The existing transport/drop suites cover parachute deployment; this is not a C-130J avionics fixture.

catalog.name: MV-22B Osprey
catalog.description: RUNAWAY-refit MV-22B production transport in the rotary dev world: depart vertically, convert to wing-borne flight, then benchmark airplane transit and finish a troop delivery. This uses the AI pilot and a scripted island landing zone.

catalog.name: RW-3 WASP
catalog.description: Five fictional ducted-fan drones fly the existing swarm/ambush demo around a scripted Huey. Verify powered maneuvering and finite flight, then benchmark the live swarm. These are setting-specific physics, not a real aircraft claim.

catalog.name: RW-4 SHRIKE
catalog.description: Fictional single-engine fighter patrol using the production AI flight model. The demo opponent is hidden and removed from combat to isolate the unit. Check bank maneuvering and no afterburner, then benchmark live CAP.

catalog.name: MQ-9 Reaper
catalog.description: Production turboprop UAV in its existing orbit demo: verify patrol, power and prop rotation, benchmark live loiter, then use the model host to check and photograph a stopped pusher. Shutdown gauge behavior is covered by the Node role bench.

catalog.name: SHAHED-style drone
catalog.description: Existing simplified delta-drone salvo in the air dev world, with the interceptor disabled for an isolated flight sample. Check forward flight after launch and capture the pusher model at rest. No claim of real guidance or weapon fidelity.

catalog.name: Marine paratrooper / repair team
catalog.description: Scripted main-game emergency release: place the real KC-130R above the home pad, ring its bailout bell, and advance to canopy inflation. Benchmark three live descending Marines and check landing. Aircraft approach, jumpmaster checklist and static-line sequencing are bypassed in this short fixture.
